questions.title: Finding the faulty fuses

manual.title: Variance of a scaled variable
manual.prompt: $X$ has $E(X)=4$ and $\mathrm{Var}(X)=2$. Find $E(3X-1)$ and $\mathrm{Var}(3X-1)$, and $E(X^{2})$.

manual.title: Testing independence
manual.prompt: $P(A)=0.4$, $P(B)=0.5$ and $P(A\cup B)=0.7$. Find $P(A\cap B)$, decide whether $A$ and $B$ are independent, and find $P(A\mid B)$.

manual.title: Mean and variance from a table
manual.prompt: A random variable has $P(X=0)=0.1$, $P(X=1)=0.3$, $P(X=2)=0.4$, $P(X=3)=0.2$. Find $E(X)$ and $\mathrm{Var}(X)$.

manual.title: Conditional probability from a two-way table
manual.prompt: In a survey of $200$ people, $80$ are under $30$; of these $50$ use app X. Of the rest, $30$ use app X. Find $P(\text{uses X})$ and $P(\text{under }30\mid\text{uses X})$.

manual.title: Fairness of a dice game
manual.prompt: A player pays $\$4$ to roll a fair die and receives the number shown in dollars. Find the expected gain per game and comment on fairness.

manual.title: Relative frequency versus theory
manual.prompt: A coin is tossed $200$ times and shows $120$ heads. Find the relative frequency of heads and comment on whether the coin may be biased.

manual.title: Distribution proportional to x
manual.prompt: $P(X=x)=kx$ for $x=1,2,3,4$. Find $k$ and $E(X)$.

manual.title: Mean and variance of a linear function
manual.prompt: $E(X)=2$ and $\mathrm{Var}(X)=1.5$. Find $E(3X-1)$ and $\mathrm{Var}(3X-1)$.

manual.title: Estimating probability from trials
manual.prompt: A three-colour spinner is spun $300$ times: red $110$, blue $95$, green $95$. Estimate $P(\text{red})$ to three decimal places and comment on whether the spinner seems fair.

manual.title: Neither event from given probabilities
manual.prompt: $P(A)=0.5$, $P(B)=0.4$ and $P(A\cap B)=0.15$. Complete a Venn diagram and find $P(\text{neither})$ and $P(A\text{ only})$.

diagram.alt: 2 circles are drawn. Labels shown: ?, 0.15, A, B. Read the question for what it asks.

manual.title: Choosing a letter
manual.prompt: A letter is chosen at random from the word MATHS. Find the probability it is a vowel, and the probability it is not.

manual.title: Reversing a conditional probability
manual.prompt: $P(A)=0.3$, $P(B\mid A)=0.5$ and $P(B\mid A')=0.2$. Find $P(B)$ and $P(A\mid B)$.

manual.title: Variance with a negative value
manual.prompt: $X$ takes values $-1$, $0$ and $2$ with probabilities $0.2$, $0.5$ and $0.3$. Find $E(X)$ and $\mathrm{Var}(X)$.

manual.title: Probability of a sum with two dice
manual.prompt: Two dice are rolled. Find the probability the sum is $7$, and the probability the sum is at least $10$.

manual.title: Independence from a two-way table
manual.prompt: Of $100$ students, $40$ play sport, $30$ play music, and $12$ do both. Are playing sport and playing music independent?

manual.title: Expected winnings in a game
manual.prompt: A spinner gives $\$0$ with probability $0.5$, $\$2$ with probability $0.3$ and $\$10$ with probability $0.2$. A game costs $\$3$. Find the expected gain and the standard deviation of the payout, to two decimal places.

manual.title: Multistage experiment with a coin and die
manual.prompt: A coin is tossed and a die is rolled. List the size of the sample space and find $P(\text{head and an even number})$.

manual.title: Complementary events with a spinner
manual.prompt: A spinner has $8$ equal sectors numbered $1$ to $8$. Find $P(\text{prime})$ and $P(\text{not a multiple of }3)$.

manual.title: Medical test with a false positive rate
manual.prompt: A disease affects $2\%$ of people. A test is positive for $95\%$ of those with it and $5\%$ of those without. Find $P(\text{positive})$ and $P(\text{disease}\mid\text{positive})$, to three decimal places.

manual.title: Unknown probability in a distribution
manual.prompt: $X$ takes values $1,2,3$ with $P(X=1)=0.2$, $P(X=2)=a$ and $P(X=3)=2a$. Find $a$ and $E(X)$.

manual.title: Probability with a two-way table
manual.prompt: In a class, $12$ of $20$ girls and $9$ of $15$ boys wear glasses. A student is chosen at random. Find $P(\text{glasses})$ and $P(\text{girl}\mid\text{glasses})$.

manual.title: Mutually exclusive versus independent
manual.prompt: $P(A)=0.3$ and $P(B)=0.5$. Find $P(A\cup B)$ if (a) $A$ and $B$ are mutually exclusive, (b) independent.

manual.title: Variance from a uniform discrete distribution
manual.prompt: $X$ is the score on a fair four-sided die (values $1$ to $4$). Find $E(X)$ and $\mathrm{Var}(X)$.

manual.title: Probability of an even sum with two dice
manual.prompt: Two dice are rolled. Find the probability the sum is even, and that the product is even.

manual.title: Expected number of heads
manual.prompt: Three fair coins are tossed. Let $X$ be the number of heads. Write the probability distribution of $X$ and find $E(X)$.

manual.title: Probability with a deck subset
manual.prompt: A card is drawn from a standard deck. Find $P(\text{picture card})$ and $P(\text{a heart or a picture card})$.

manual.title: Mean of a discrete distribution with an unknown
manual.prompt: $X$ has values $0,1,2,3$ with probabilities $0.1$, $p$, $0.4$, $q$, and $E(X)=1.9$. Find $p$ and $q$.

manual.title: Relative frequency from a dice experiment
manual.prompt: A die is rolled $120$ times and shows $1$ on $28$ occasions. Compare the relative frequency of $1$ with the theoretical probability.

manual.title: Conditional probability and independence from a union
manual.prompt: $P(A)=0.5$, $P(B)=0.4$ and $P(A\cup B)=0.7$. Find $P(A\cap B)$ and $P(A\mid B)$, and decide whether $A$ and $B$ are independent.

manual.title: Distribution decreasing linearly from one to four
manual.prompt: A random variable takes the values $1,2,3,4$ with probabilities given by $P(X=x)=k(5-x)$. Find the constant $k$ and the expected value of $X$.

manual.title: Venn diagram for soccer and tennis
manual.prompt: In a class of $30$, $18$ play soccer, $12$ play tennis and $5$ play both. Draw a Venn diagram and find the probability a randomly chosen student plays neither.

diagram.alt: 2 circles are drawn. Labels shown: 13, 7, 5, S, T. Read the question for what it asks.

manual.title: Vaccination and flu from a two way table
manual.prompt: Of $200$ people, $120$ were vaccinated. $15$ vaccinated and $30$ unvaccinated people caught flu. Find $P(\text{flu}\mid\text{not vaccinated})$ and $P(\text{vaccinated}\mid\text{flu})$.

manual.title: Expected gain in a dice game costing three dollars
manual.prompt: A game costs $\$3$. A fair die is rolled: a six wins $\$10$, a five wins $\$2$, otherwise nothing. Find the expected gain per game.

manual.title: Positive test result for a rare condition
manual.prompt: A condition affects $2\%$ of people. A test is positive for $95\%$ of people with it and for $10\%$ of people without it. Find the probability that a randomly chosen person tests positive, and the probability that a person who tests positive has the condition.

diagram.alt: Diagram. Labels shown: C, +, 0.95, -, 0.05, 0.02, C prime, 0.1, 0.9, 0.98. Read the question for what it asks.

manual.title: Variance of a three valued distribution
manual.prompt: $X$ takes values $0,1,2$ with probabilities $0.3,0.5,0.2$. Find $E(X)$, $\mathrm{Var}(X)$ and the standard deviation.

manual.title: Relative frequency of sixes
manual.prompt: A die is rolled $300$ times and shows $62$ sixes. Estimate the probability of a six from this data, predict the number of sixes in $1200$ rolls, and comment on whether the die seems fair.

manual.title: Two unknown probabilities from a given mean
manual.prompt: $X$ takes values $0,1,2,3$ with probabilities $0.1$, $a$, $0.3$, $b$, and $E(X)=1.9$. Find $a$ and $b$.

manual.title: Which machine made the faulty part
manual.prompt: Machine A makes $60\%$ of a factory's parts, $3\%$ of them faulty; machine B makes the rest, $5\%$ faulty. A part is chosen at random. Find the probability it is faulty, and the probability it came from A given that it is faulty.

diagram.alt: Diagram. Labels shown: A, F, 0.03, G, 0.97, 0.6, B, 0.05, 0.95, 0.4. Read the question for what it asks.

manual.title: Prize that makes a game fair
manual.prompt: A game costs $\$5$ to play. A player wins a prize of $\$x$ with probability $\tfrac18$ and nothing otherwise. Find $x$ so that the game is fair.

manual.title: Testing independence from a two way table
manual.prompt: In a survey of $125$ people: $30$ men and $20$ women prefer tea; $45$ men and $30$ women prefer coffee. Are "is a man" and "prefers tea" independent? Justify.

manual.title: Number of heads in three tosses
manual.prompt: Three fair coins are tossed and $X$ is the number of heads. Write the probability distribution of $X$ and find $E(X)$.

manual.title: Conditional probabilities when one event contains another
manual.prompt: Event $A$ is contained in event $B$, with $P(A)=0.2$ and $P(B)=0.5$. Find $P(A\mid B)$ and $P(B\mid A)$, explaining the second.

manual.title: Distribution with probabilities x plus one over fourteen
manual.prompt: A random variable has $P(X=x)=\dfrac{x+1}{14}$ for $x=1,2,3,4$. Verify this is a probability distribution, and find $E(X)$ and $P(X\ge3)$.

manual.title: Expected payout from a spinner with unequal sectors
manual.prompt: A spinner has sectors of $180^\circ$, $120^\circ$ and $60^\circ$ paying $\$1$, $\$3$ and $\$9$. Find the expected payout per spin.

diagram.alt: 1 circle is drawn. Read the question for what it asks.

manual.title: Late to work by bus or train
manual.prompt: Sam takes the bus with probability $0.7$, otherwise the train. He is late $10\%$ of the time by bus and $5\%$ by train. Find $P(\text{late})$ and $P(\text{train}\mid\text{late})$.

diagram.alt: Diagram. Labels shown: Bus, L, 0.1, O, 0.9, 0.7, Train, 0.05, 0.95, 0.3. Read the question for what it asks.

manual.title: Variance of a one two three distribution
manual.prompt: $X$ takes values $1,2,3$ with probabilities $0.2,0.5,0.3$. Find $E(X)$ and $\mathrm{Var}(X)$.
hints: Subtract the square of the mean.

ladder.method: Subtract the square of the mean.

manual.title: Number of sixes in two rolls
manual.prompt: A die is rolled twice and $X$ is the number of sixes. Write the probability distribution of $X$ and find $E(X)$.

manual.title: Estimating from five hundred trials
manual.prompt: In $500$ trials of an experiment, $140$ were successes. Estimate the probability of success, and the expected number of successes in $2000$ further trials.
